lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10-11 distinct vertical white line segments observed on the torso; spacing is relatively equidistant throughout the mid-section, becoming increasingly fragmented toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 8th vertical line from the shoulder where the lower segment splits into distinct spot clusters.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Significant line discontinuity observed on the 1st, 9th, 10th, and 11th vertical segments, which transition into dashed blobs or discrete spot patterns.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High density grouping of approximately 12-15 discrete white spots localized on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Visible diagonal alignment of spots on the upper thigh that continues the trajectory of the posterior torso stripes.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial markings including a chevron between the eyes, a singular white spot on the lower cheek, and a broad white crescent patch on the ventral neck/throat area.
